name: Real Estate Agent (AMLR obliged)
description: Real estate agency — residential, commercial, lettings. AMLR Article 3 obliged entity. Letting agents become obliged on a €10k/month rental threshold. Focus: BO verification on foreign buyers, SoF evidence on high-value sales, sanctions at both buyer and UBO level, PEP identification.

recommends_fcp_domains.rationale: Foreign buyers, nominee acquisition risk; screening at buyer + UBO level.
